frontier: CE − cash against base-scenario breach for each strategy family (us_mkt, normal start). Lines sweep each family's knob; stars are the robust-tuned versions actually evaluated. Dashed: the 2% mandate; dotted: the 1.25% tuning target. Source: scripts/07_report_numbers.py → results/report/inputs/frontier_us_mkt.parquet, dp_lambda_frontier_us_mkt.parquet
cdf: Distribution of terminal wealth, us_mkt, T = 2, base scenario (5,000-path subsample of the 50,000 evaluation paths). Dashed: the $95M floor; dotted: 2% probability. Source: scripts/07_report_numbers.py → results/report/inputs/terminal_base.npz
policy: Premium-robust DP policy for us_mkt at the λ* of the normal state, T = 2 (λ = 0.00261). y = 1 (dashed) is the conservative floor PV. Dotted lines mark the named starting states' σ0. Source: scripts/07_report_numbers.py → results/report/inputs/policy_us_mkt.npz (from results/policies/dp_premrobust_us_mkt.npz)
heatmap: Worst-case breach over the robust model set (base, GARCH-t DGP, filtered historical simulation, parameter uncertainty, persistent vol), us_mkt, by starting σ0 and horizon; 50,000 evaluation paths per cell. The colour bar's black line is the 2% mandate. Source: scripts/07_report_numbers.py → results/report/tables/all_cells.csv
stress: Breach under the tuning scenarios and under stress scenarios held out of tuning, maximum over the five named starting states, us_mkt. Dashed: 2%. Source: scripts/07_report_numbers.py → results/report/tables/all_cells.csv
industries: Deployed strategy on every asset (the rule's choice). Bars: maximum over the named-state × horizon cells; industries at 20,000 evaluation paths. Assets without a μ = 0 bar were not evaluated under that stress. Source: scripts/07_report_numbers.py → results/report/tables/industries.csv, results/deployment.csv
